display.title: Episode 381: Judge for a Day, Chapter 3
display.summary_short: Memories of Shavuos and 'tzedakah for the soul', the first march after Sefirah, and the last chapter of 'Judge for a Day', in which young Label solves the case in a real courtroom.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on 10 Sivan 5749, the week after Shavuos. Uncle Yossi recalls the Shavuos flowers that remind us of Har Sinai and the all-night Tikkun Leil Shavuos, with readings from Tanach, Mishnah, Sefer Yetzirah, the Zohar and the 613 mitzvos. The best thanks for the Torah is to learn more and to help others learn, which is tzedakah for a hungry soul. With Sefirah over, the Hakochainik march returns. A whole family of five children leads the Shema, and their father blesses the listeners. The final chapter of 'Judge for a Day' follows: the judge who watched the children's game invites Label to be judge for a day. In the packed courtroom Label drops the gold coins into hot water, oil rises to the surface, and Ivan the tailor confesses that he spied through a hole in the wall. Beryl the butcher gets his money back and thanks Hashem, and Label grows up to be the great Shaagas Aryeh. A listener's letter from the mailbox and Shabbos candle times close the show.
display.lesson: Thank Hashem for the Torah by learning more and helping others learn; Hashem answers the prayers of the honest and uses even a child to bring out the truth.
